description:
Indicates that the data pushed to the standard output stream by the command will be redirected
to this CWL output.

Can be defined for only one output. If combined with 'stdout' at the root of the CWL document,
that definition will indicate the desired name of the output file where the output stream will
be written to. A random name will be applied for the file of this output unless otherwise
specified.
title: CWLOutputStdOut
